citations.claim: EW still yellow, 4th second of yellow
all-red reached after only 4s yellow, violating yellow_seconds=6

counterfactual.change: Set actuated from true to false (fixed-time cycle); yellow then lasts full 6s and violation disappears

explanation: Actuated controller truncates yellow early. EW yellow starts at step 184 but all-red is entered at step 188, so yellow lasted only 4s (184-187) instead of required 6s. With actuated=false the same scenario shows no violation, proving actuated-phase logic is responsible for the early yellow termination.
vision_note: Steps 185-187 show the intersection with two opposing signals yellow (orange/yellow dots) and the other two red. At step 188 all four signals are red, meaning the yellow phase was terminated early and the intersection entered all-red after only three visible yellow frames.
